replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: I have always seen mathematics as a practical tool rather than an abstract passion. It helps me manage budgets, understand recipes, and make sense of the world. While I enjoy solving puzzles, I don't pursue it for its own sake, preferring real-world applications over theoretical exploration.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Occasionally, yes. When I encounter complex equations or time-sensitive calculations, a mild anxiety surfaces, especially if I feel unprepared. However, my low openness and moderate conscientiousness mean I usually avoid pushing too deep, so anxiety remains limited and manageable.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Yes, I used an AI tutor to review basic algebra for a home project. It was helpful for quick explanations and checking my work, though it sometimes oversimplified concepts. The experience was positive overall, offering clarity without overwhelming me, fitting my moderate conscientiousness and low openness to deep study.
